title: Negative control: unsupported spell narrated as working
description: Negative control. The same unsupported spell is narrated as paralysing the goblin. The narration guard must remove that claim, so fidelity.claimed_effects fails.
player_input: I cast Wish on the goblin to stop it.

play.consequence_planner.mechanical_summary: Lyra casts Wish on the goblin. The engine has no effect for this spell, so the goblin is unchanged.

scripted.play.narrator: You speak the word and the air hums. The goblin is paralyzed and cannot move. It glares at you over its bared teeth.
